terra.problem: The classroom comparison brings in a school setting, which the audience rule excludes.
The snack joke mentions food other than cookies.
Abraham rules out the daughters of the Canaanites among whom he lives, not all neighbors.
The casserole joke mentions food other than cookies.
The explanation says the land promise is why Abraham forbids taking Isaac back. The passage does not state that reason.
The explanation gives the servant a map, which the passage does not mention.
“Wrong spot” uses the prohibited word “wrong” about the baker’s answer.
The passage does not say the servant runs to Rebekah the second he sees her.
The passage does not specify that Rebekah makes a lot of trips. “I get tired just watching” also suggests Papa watched the Bible event.
The passage does not say how many trips Rebekah makes, so “a whole lot of trips” adds a detail.
“Payment isn’t on his mind” states what the servant is thinking beyond what the text says.
The passage does not say the servant has traveled for a long day.
The servant also speaks of the LORD leading him to his master’s relatives, so kindness and faithfulness are not the whole focus of his words.
